title.narrative: Provision of life-saving WASH supplies and services to children and their families affected by the crisis in the Gaza Strip

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project addresses urgent WASH needs for 100,000 vulnerable Palestinians, including IDPs and Returnees in Southern and Middle Gaza,ltbgt by ensuring access to safe water, sanitation, and hygiene. With severe well destruction, there is little domestic water, increasing public health risks as potable water is used for sanitation, leading to long queues at distribution points.lt/bgtltbrgtltbgtTo ease pressure on potable water and improve hygiene, the project will repair wells and establish community-managed water distribution points in shelters and sites near these wells. This fills a critical gap in the humanitarian response and supports positive public health outcomes. UNICEF's ongoing efforts in South and Middle Gaza, including potable water trucking, sanitation kit distribution, and hygiene promotion, will be strengthened through this initiative.lt/bgtltbrgtltbrgtltspangtltbgtIn areas with a high number of Returnees, wastewater is currently disposed to the direct environment, as connections to the sewer system has been severed. These pollution hotspots pose a significant health risk, and in partnership with the PWA, the CMWU and community leaders, the project will identify such hotspots and ensure household connections to the sewage system, desludging and cleaning of the sewers and evacuation of sewage from the populated areas.lt/bgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtThe proposed Project focuses on the following key objectives:ltbrgtOutput 1.1 - Access to water: UNICEF will ltbgtorganize the creation, operation and maintenance of community domestic water distribution and management points in sites and shelters for returnees (100,000 beneficiaries), consisting of well repair (including generators), water storage through rigid tanks and water distribution through stand-pies and filling points.lt/bgt Potable water is currently distributed to the population at a high costs per cubic meter ($20-30/m3), but because the large-scale destruction of wells providing domestic water, the potable water distributed by water tankers mostly is the sole source of water, and therefore also has to meet the needs for domestic water use (cleaning, washing, sanitation). Therefore, the focus of this activity is to significantly increase the production of domestic water through the rehabilitation of wells and discrete parts of the network and erecting ltbgtcommunity-managedlt/bgt domestic water storage and distribution points throughout southern and middle Gaza, which will reduce the demand for potable and will provide domestic water at a fraction of the costs of potable water. In addition to the repair of domestic water wells and community distribution points, small desalination plants financed under other grants will be connected to these wells to create a network of decentralized community-managed potable water distribution points. A similar approach is currently being implemented in Northern Gaza (Beit Hanoun, Beit Lahya, Jabalya), financed under other grants. ltbgt Sites will be selected based on priority lists maintained by the CMWU and the PWA based on requests for assistance from the communities in southern and middle Gaza.lt/bgtltbrgtOutput 1.2 - Sanitation: With the return of IDPs to southern and middle Gaza, living mostly in the carcasses of the remaining buildings still standing, wltbgtastewater is disposed uncontrolled to the adjacent environmentlt/bgt. UltbgtNICEF in cooperation with the PWA and the CMWU, based on community requests, will identify priority wastewater hotspots, and where possible will re-connect Returnees shelters and siteslt/bgt to the sewer system conducting critical repairs to blocked parts of the sewer system ltbgtso that the wastewater is disposed in a controlled manner. lt/bgt Latrine construction where possible is financed by ongoing complementary grants. Efficient discharge of sewage will not only prevent the spread of diseases but also contribute to the overall well-being and dignity of the affected population.ltbrgtlt/pgt
